dataset_source: Tencent / KDD Cup 2012, distributed through OpenML dataset 1220 (version 5)
licence: Public, as declared by OpenML dataset metadata; upstream terms are not separately specified there
preparation: 39,948 ad-context records distributed by OpenML as Click_prediction_small. There are 33,220 no-click and 6,728 click labels before deduplication; the publisher explicitly downsampled negatives to roughly a 5:1 ratio. This is a replacement benchmark, not the original receipt-ad MySQL dataset. A label denotes at least one click in an aggregated ad context, not the click count divided by impressions. The raw CSV is kept local and restored with `fetch_data.py`; only metrics and derived results are published, since the OpenML licence field is the generic 'Public'.
